findings.title: File handle leaked in read_report
findings.body: According to custom instructions in 'Error Handling Standards' (Every I/O operation must have error handling to ensure resources are released.): The function opens a file and appends the handle to `_open_reports` but never closes it. If an exception occurs during `report.read()`, the file handle is left open. Even on success, the file remains open until the program ends, leaking file descriptors. Use a context manager to ensure the file is closed, or if there is a need to track open files, provide a mechanism to close them and handle errors appropriately.
findings.suggestion:
with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as report:
        return report.read()

summary.problem: The function read_report leaks file descriptors and lacks proper error handling for I/O operations.
summary.done_well: The function reads and returns the file content when successful.
